actions.google_news_search.props.async.d: The ID-only option gives no results and needs cached results allowed.
actions.google_news_search.props.cost_no: Every new search counts against your SerpApi plan. Repeating the same search within an hour is free if cached results are allowed.
actions.google_news_search.props.no_cach: Cached results are free and up to an hour old.
JSON gives structured data; HTML is the raw results page.
actions.google_news_search.props.query.d: What to search Google News for.
actions.google_search.description: Search Google and get the results as seen from a place and language.
actions.google_search.props.async.descri: The ID-only option gives no results and needs cached results allowed.
actions.google_search.props.cost_note.de: Every new search counts against your SerpApi plan. Repeating the same search within an hour is free if cached results are allowed.
actions.google_search.props.device.descr: Get the results a desktop, phone or tablet would see.
actions.google_search.props.filter.descr: Hide results Google treats as near duplicates.
actions.google_search.props.google_domai: Which Google site to search, such as google.co.uk.
actions.google_search.props.location.des: Results as seen from this place.
actions.google_search.props.location_sea: Type a city or region, then pick the match in Location.
actions.google_search.props.no_cache.des: Cached results are free and up to an hour old.
How many results to return, from 1 to 100.
actions.google_search.props.query.descri: What to search for on Google.
actions.google_search.props.start.descri: Skip this many results to get later pages.
actions.google_trends_search.description: See how interest in a search term changes over time and by region.
actions.google_trends_search.props.async: The ID-only option gives no results and needs cached results allowed.
actions.google_trends_search.props.categ: Category ID from SerpApi's Google Trends list; 0 means all.
actions.google_trends_search.props.cost_: Every new search counts against your SerpApi plan. Repeating the same search within an hour is free if cached results are allowed.
actions.google_trends_search.props.data_: What to measure about the search term.
actions.google_trends_search.props.geo.d: Region whose search interest is measured.
actions.google_trends_search.props.no_ca: Cached results are free and up to an hour old.
actions.google_trends_search.props.outpu: JSON gives structured data; HTML is the raw results page.
actions.google_trends_search.props.prope: Which Google search the interest comes from.
actions.google_trends_search.props.query: Up to 5 terms, comma-separated, for Interest Over Time or Compare Terms by Region.
actions.search_apple_app_store.descripti: Search the iOS Apple App Store for apps matching a term.
actions.search_apple_app_store.props.cou: Two-letter App Store country/storefront code, e.g. "us", "gb". Optional.
actions.search_apple_app_store.props.lan: Language code for results, e.g. "en-us". Optional.
actions.search_apple_app_store.props.num: Number of results to return. Optional.
actions.search_apple_app_store.props.ter: The app or keyword to search for, e.g. "meditation".
actions.search_bing.description: Run a Bing web search for a query.
actions.search_bing.props.cc.description: Two-letter country code to scope results, e.g. "us", "gb". Optional.
actions.search_bing.props.count.descript: Number of results to return per page. Optional.
actions.search_bing.props.first.descript: One-based index of the first result to return, for pagination. Optional.
actions.search_bing.props.mkt.descriptio: Market locale in language-country form, e.g. "en-US", "de-DE". Optional.
actions.search_bing.props.query.descript: The web search query to execute, e.g. "climate change report".
actions.search_duckduckgo.description: Run a DuckDuckGo web search for a query.
actions.search_duckduckgo.props.kl.descr: Region locale in country-language form, e.g. "us-en", "uk-en", "de-de". Optional.
actions.search_duckduckgo.props.query.de: The web search query to execute, e.g. "open source databases".
actions.search_google_images.description: Discover images on Google Images for a query.
actions.search_google_images.props.gl.de: Two-character lowercase ISO 3166-1 country code, e.g. "us", "gb". Optional.
actions.search_google_images.props.hl.de: Two-character lowercase ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. "en", "es". Optional.
actions.search_google_images.props.ijn.d: Zero-based page index for image pagination (0 = first page, 1 = second, ...). Optional.
actions.search_google_images.props.num_r: Number of image results to return (up to 100). Optional.
actions.search_google_images.props.query: What images to search for, e.g. "golden gate bridge".
actions.search_google_jobs.description: Find job listings on Google Jobs for a query.
actions.search_google_jobs.props.gl.desc: Two-character lowercase ISO 3166-1 country code, e.g. "us", "gb". Optional.
actions.search_google_jobs.props.hl.desc: Two-character lowercase ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. "en", "es". Optional.
actions.search_google_jobs.props.locatio: Free-text location, e.g. "New York, NY". SerpApi resolves it server-side. Optional.
actions.search_google_jobs.props.ltype.d: Set to "1" to return only work-from-home jobs. Optional.
actions.search_google_jobs.props.next_pa: Pagination token from the `next_page_token` field of a previous response. Optional.
actions.search_google_jobs.props.query.d: The job role to search for, e.g. "software engineer".
actions.search_google_lens.description: Run a reverse-image (visual) search on Google Lens for an image URL.
actions.search_google_lens.props.country: Two-letter country code for results, e.g. "us", "gb". Optional.
actions.search_google_lens.props.query.d: Optional text query to refine the visual search.
actions.search_google_lens.props.type.de: Lens search type, e.g. "all" (default), "products", or "visual_matches". Optional.
actions.search_google_lens.props.url.des: Publicly accessible URL of the image to analyze, e.g. "https://example.com/photo.jpg".
actions.search_google_local_services.des: Find local-services-ads providers for a service category in a region.
actions.search_google_local_services.pro: Opaque region identifier (data_cid) for the local-services area. Must be supplied by the caller; this piece has no resolver for it.
The service category to search for, e.g. "plumber" or "electrician".
actions.search_google_maps.description: Find local businesses and places on Google Maps for a query.
actions.search_google_maps.props.gl.desc: Two-character lowercase ISO 3166-1 country code, e.g. "us", "gb". Optional.
actions.search_google_maps.props.hl.desc: Two-character lowercase ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. "en", "es". Optional.
actions.search_google_maps.props.ll.desc: GPS coordinates of the map center as "@latitude,longitude,zoom", e.g. "@40.7455096,-74.0083012,14z". Required once you paginate with Start. Optional otherwise.
actions.search_google_maps.props.query.d: What to search for, e.g. "coffee shops" or "Pizza Hut".
actions.search_google_maps.props.start.d: Zero-based offset for pagination (multiples of 20). Requires Map Center (ll). Optional.
actions.search_google_news_ai.descriptio: Search Google News for recent articles matching a query.
actions.search_google_news_ai.props.gl.d: Two-character lowercase ISO 3166-1 country code, e.g. "us", "gb", "de". Optional.
actions.search_google_news_ai.props.hl.d: Two-character lowercase ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. "en", "es", "fr". Optional.
actions.search_google_news_ai.props.quer: The news search query, e.g. "renewable energy policy".
actions.search_google_play.description: Search the Google Play store for apps, games, movies, or books.
actions.search_google_play.props.apps_ca: Optional Google Play apps category filter, e.g. "GAME_PUZZLE".
actions.search_google_play.props.gl.desc: Two-character lowercase ISO 3166-1 country code, e.g. "us", "gb". Optional.
actions.search_google_play.props.hl.desc: Two-character lowercase ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. "en", "es". Optional.
actions.search_google_play.props.next_pa: Pagination token from the `next_page_token` field of a previous response. Optional.
actions.search_google_play.props.query.d: What to search for, e.g. "puzzle games".
actions.search_google_scholar.descriptio: Search academic papers and citations on Google Scholar for a query.
actions.search_google_scholar.props.as_y: Upper bound of the publication year range, e.g. 2024. Optional.
Lower bound of the publication year range, e.g. 2018. Optional.
actions.search_google_scholar.props.hl.d: Two-character lowercase ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. "en", "es". Optional.
actions.search_google_scholar.props.num_: Number of results to return (1-20). Optional.
actions.search_google_scholar.props.quer: The academic search query, e.g. "transformer neural networks".
actions.search_google_scholar.props.star: Zero-based offset for pagination (multiples of 10). Optional.
actions.search_google_shopping.descripti: Find products on Google Shopping for a query.
Two-character lowercase ISO 3166-1 country code, e.g. "us", "gb". Optional.
Two-character lowercase ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. "en", "es". Optional.
actions.search_google_shopping.props.que: The product to search for, e.g. "wireless headphones".
actions.search_google_shopping.props.sta: Zero-based offset for pagination (multiples of 60). Optional.
actions.search_google_trends_ai.descript: Query Google Trends for interest in a keyword over time and across regions.
actions.search_google_trends_ai.props.ca: Google Trends category id (0 for all categories). Optional.
actions.search_google_trends_ai.props.da: Type of trends data: one of "TIMESERIES" (interest over time, default), "GEO_MAP" (interest by region), "RELATED_TOPICS", or "RELATED_QUERIES". Optional.
Trends date range token, e.g. "today 12-m" (past 12 months), "today 5-y", "now 7-d", or "all". Optional.
actions.search_google_trends_ai.props.ge: Uppercase two-letter region code to scope the trend to, e.g. "US", "GB", "JP". Leave empty for worldwide. Optional.
actions.search_google_trends_ai.props.gp: Google property to filter by: empty for web, or "images", "news", "froogle" (shopping), "youtube". Optional.
actions.search_google_trends_ai.props.hl: Two-character lowercase ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. "en", "es", "fr". Optional.
actions.search_google_trends_ai.props.qu: The keyword or topic to analyze trends for, e.g. "artificial intelligence".
actions.search_google_web_ai.description: Run a Google web search and return organic results for a query.
actions.search_google_web_ai.props.devic: Device to simulate: one of "desktop", "mobile", or "tablet". Optional.
actions.search_google_web_ai.props.gl.de: Two-character lowercase ISO 3166-1 country code, e.g. "us", "gb", "de". Optional.
actions.search_google_web_ai.props.hl.de: Two-character lowercase ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. "en", "es", "fr". Optional.
actions.search_google_web_ai.props.locat: Free-text geographic location to originate the search from, e.g. "Austin, Texas, United States". SerpApi resolves it server-side. Optional.
actions.search_google_web_ai.props.num_r: Number of results to return (1-100). Optional.
actions.search_google_web_ai.props.query: The web search query to execute, e.g. "best electric cars 2024".
actions.search_walmart.description: Find products on Walmart for a query.
actions.search_walmart.props.max_price.d: Highest product price to include. Optional.
actions.search_walmart.props.min_price.d: Lowest product price to include. Optional.
Lowest average rating to include (e.g. 4). Optional.
actions.search_walmart.props.query.descr: The product to search for, e.g. "office chair".
actions.search_walmart.props.store_id.de: Walmart store id to scope availability. Optional.
actions.search_yelp.description: Find businesses and reviews on Yelp for a category and location.
actions.search_yelp.props.find_desc.desc: What to search for, e.g. "italian restaurants" or "auto repair".
actions.search_yelp.props.find_loc.descr: Where to search, e.g. "San Francisco, CA".
actions.search_yelp.props.start.descript: Zero-based offset for pagination (multiples of 10). Optional.
actions.search_yelp.props.yelp_domain.de: Yelp domain to use, e.g. "yelp.com" (default). Optional.
actions.search_youtube_ai.description: Search YouTube for videos matching a query.
actions.search_youtube_ai.props.gl.descr: Two-character lowercase ISO 3166-1 country code, e.g. "us", "gb", "de". Optional.
actions.search_youtube_ai.props.hl.descr: Two-character lowercase ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. "en", "es", "fr". Optional.
actions.search_youtube_ai.props.query.de: The YouTube search query, e.g. "how to bake sourdough".

actions.youtube_search.props.no_cache.de: Cached results are free and up to an hour old.
actions.youtube_search.props.output.desc: JSON gives structured data; HTML is the raw results page.
